# xmatters_person (Data Source)

Returns a person in your xMatters instance using their unique identifier (UUID) or target name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "xmatters_person" "get_person_by_id" {
  person_id = "mmcbride"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `person_id` (String) Unique identifier (UUID) or target name of the xMatters user.

### Read-Only

- `external_key` (String) Unique identifier of the user in an external system.
- `externally_owned` (Boolean) Whether the user is managed by an external system.
- `first_name` (String) First name of the user.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier (UUID) of the xMatters user.
- `language` (String) Default language of the user.
- `last_login` (String)
- `last_name` (String) Last name of the user.
- `license_type` (String) License type of the user in xMatters. Available options are: FULL_USER, STAKEHOLDER_USER.
- `phone_login` (String) Access code used to retrieve phone messages from xMatters.
- `roles` (Set of String) List of the user's assigned role names.
- `site` (String) Unique identifier (UUID) of the xMatters site the user is assigned to.
- `status` (String) Status of the user. Available options are: ACTIVE,  INACTIVE.
- `supervisors` (Set of String) List of unique identifiers (UUIDs) that represent the user's supervisors.
- `target_name` (String) User ID in xMatters consisting of a combination of letters and numbers up to 100 characters.
- `timezone` (String) Time zone where the user is located.
- `web_login` (String) Identifier used to log in to the xMatters user interface. This is often identical to the targetName value.
